perks.name: Vigilant Watch
perks.description: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
perks.exact:

Linearly? grants up to +? Stability and +? Handling

While at Critical Health:
Weapon Kills restore 30HP.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between triggers.

perks.name: Iron Conviction
perks.description: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:

+35 Ammo Generation Stat, ?% Flinch Resist, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants within 10 meters for 7 seconds.
Additional kills while the buff is active refreshes the buff duration.

Buff cannot retrigger until any Shield HP is recovered.
